english_command: Create a class for a Person with name and age
code:
class Person
  def initialize(name, age)
    @name = name
    @age = age
  end
  
  def greet
    puts "Hello, my name is #{@name} and I am #{@age} years old."
  end
end

person = Person.new("John", 30)
person.greet
